title: Contrix Agent Protocol Envelope
description: Wire shape for the cx.agent.* protocol family (endpoint, protocol_session.start/status/result). Mirrors cx.schema.applet.v1 but terminates in a *.result event carrying the signed audit binding. See spec/v1/zh/extensions/agent-protocol-interop.md. Note: cx.schema.agent_authority.v1 is a different schema covering the agent-authority panel projection, not the protocol envelope.

agent_id.description: Stable agent runtime identifier. v1 uses a DID here; cx:agent:* is not a registered typed-id kind. Agent task/session object ids use cx:agent_task:* and cx:agent_session:* in their own fields.

endpoint_url.description: HTTPS endpoint advertised by cx.agent.endpoint events.

session_id.description: Per-invocation correlation id used by protocol_session.start / .status / .result to pair request/response.

params.description: Caller-supplied parameters for protocol_session.start. Opaque to soland — agent runtimes interpret per agent manifest.

result.description: Terminal payload for cx.agent.protocol_session.result. Free-form; agents document the shape.

detail.description: Runtime-side detail surface (intermediate progress, bridge identifier, error context, etc.).

audit_binding.description: Signed audit binding emitted with the terminal *.result event so callers can prove the agent runtime executed under a specific capability grant.
